questions.statement: After the first full ascending bubble-sort pass, the largest value is in its final position.
questions.explanation: Adjacent swaps move the largest unsorted value to the end of the pass.

questions.stem: What stops a recursive procedure from calling itself indefinitely?
questions.explanation: The base case is a terminating condition that prevents further recursive calls.

questions.modelAnswer: True, because 4 is less than or equal to 6.
